subject.title: fix(teams-meetings): join and transcribe live meetings reliably

question: Should this follow-up be sponsored for the three focused reliability repairs and require inspectable redacted Teams live evidence before it can merge?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and externally unverifiable live-run claim require an explicit human decision, even though the code defects have narrow repair paths.

options.title: Repair and re-prove
options.body: Fix the timeout, CLI forwarding, and adoption retry paths, then add redacted live evidence that directly shows the repaired consumer flow.

options.title: Accept the gaps
options.body: Merge while accepting that slow joins, CLI caption probes, and transient navigation recovery may still require manual intervention.

options.title: Narrow the follow-up
options.body: Split the live-caption and browser-flow expansion from the shared-contract repairs if maintainers want a smaller independently proven change.

recommendation.title: Repair and re-prove
recommendation.body: Fix the timeout, CLI forwarding, and adoption retry paths, then add redacted live evidence that directly shows the repaired consumer flow.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged Teams feature history and the current follow-up implementation.
